label: The infinite set of three-coordinate real points is greatest under inclusion in the infinite…
meaning: The infinite set of three-coordinate real points is greatest under inclusion in the infinite family of all regions. That family is order-bounded, but the whole has no upper bound in first-coordinate extent. The same homogeneous region interpretation with empty priority violates the genus-at-being-shaped cause-all principle. A bounded open real interval has an unattained least upper bound and no maximal member; two singleton regions are maximal but not greatest within their explicit two-member family. The certificate imports unchanged prior Bool finite-top and Nat no-maximal full-background witnesses. These are mathematical order/omission controls, not actual physical infinity, metaphysical possibility, intensive perfection, genuine causality or proof of the Fourth Way.
